_comment: Positions in metres in the vehicle frame of configs/vehicle.json (x right, y front, z up from ground). Source: nuPlan suite layout on IONIQ 5 geometry (assumption until nuPlan extrinsics are transferred).

sensors.snapped: moved 0.16 m onto the car skin of the reference model
sensors.data_source: nuPlan suite (Karnchanachari et al., ICRA 2024): D3 Engineering D3RCM camera, 2000x1200 at 10 Hz; Sony IMX390 sensor, 12-bit A/D (Sony 2017); uncompressed 2000*1200*12 bit = 28.8 Mbit per frame. The real link is FPD-Link III (SerDes), modelled as a dedicated Ethernet attachment
